BOSS BATTLE\nDefeat Mauez!!
As Cipiwon said, there is a magic barrier at the\nentrance of the 2nd chamber.\nLooks like [ffff64]you need to collect the coins[ffffff]...
Who the heck are you?\nOnly undercover agents are allowed to enter here.\nGet lost!
Ruzart! Stop it!!\n...I'm sorry but what brings you here?\nOh, haven't we met in the ruined temple...?
I apologize for my insolence last time.\nBy the way, why did you... What?! To see Mauez?!\nYou need to [ffff64]go through three trials[ffffff]...
Hmm, I won't stop you if you know that.\nWell, then...
Can you [ffff64]defeat 20 magic marionettes in the garden[ffffff]?\nIt'll be easy if you two cooperate with each other.
Nooooo! I can't! I can't! I caaaan't!!
You haven't defeated 20 magic marionettes...
Great... You defeated the marionettes alone.
Heh, what are you saying?\nIt was too easy that even an ordinary person\ncan do it. You're too soft, stupid leader.
...Then, I'll tell you about the second trial in the\nfirst room. [ffff64]Collect 20 coins from the marionettes[ffffff].
Show the coins before the magic barrier and\nit will disappear. Now, go collect them.\n...Hm? Are you alright?
I've had enough! I'll stay here!\nYou go alone!!
It's alright if you insist but you need to fight\nthe magic marionettes again.\nAre you sure?
Whaaaat?!\nN-Noooooo! That is too much!!
...You're too slow.\nEscaping from those marionettes is killing me.\nI survived because it was me, you know...
Huh? It's a good workout?\nShut up!
Why meeeeeee?!
Why are you so late?!\nI had to run around dodging the magic\nattacks...!
Well, that's it, right?\nLet's go see that Mauez thing and get the\nproof. Alright?
So, you went through the trials? Great.\nAnd welcome. I'm Mauez.\nPeople call me the Moon Wizard.
And I have to fight you as a trial...
Whaaat? Oh, not again!\nA wizard wearing an armor?\nYou look very strong.
Armor?\nHa ha, It may look like an armor but it's not.\nIt's a magic device to support life.
I lost my face, left hand and leg, and lung\nin an incident.
Since then, I've been keeping myself alive using\nmy strong magic and the magic power\nin this device...
Although people still call me wizard, I can\nno longer use powerful magic like I used to.
Oh, yea? Then, it should be easy this time!\nEven I can beat a wizard who can't use magi...
Eeeeek!
Ha ha. I didn't say I can't use magic.\nI just can't use powerful magic.
Noooo! You liar!
Whoa?! That's not fair!
Wait wait. I won't fight you any more.\nI guess I can count on you...
I'll give you the proof but before that...\nCould you listen to my story?
Long time ago, me, Majua the Sun Wizard, and\nNaiata the Star Wizard tried to open the gate of\nanother world and call the Lost God, who existed
before the 12 gods to restore the earth that was\nsplit apart by the Cataclysm.
Naiata?! That's...
...However, what came out were evil and deformed\nmonsters that were far from being called Gods.
We managed to drive them back to another world\nand seal the gate.
However, I lost my face and most parts of the\nleft side of my body. Naiata lost her right ear\nand eyesight.
And Majua had to sacrifice himself to keep\nthe gate sealed...
I think the seal hasn't been broken but I can\nfeel the existence of the deformed monsters\nthese days...
If they invade this world again, it will\nfor sure lead to catastrophe.
I want you to do something about it before that.\nI'm sure you can do it. So, please!
Whoa... This guy accepted it just like that...
I appreciate it.\nThen, go to the place where Naiata creates\nholy gems. She's there.
Holy gems?!
Right. Show this proof to Tecaca.\nAnd he'll tell you how to get there...
Finally! We can go there!\nLet's go!! Thanks, Mauez!
